title: Performance Marketing
description:
**Performance Marketing — Meta \& Google Ads** 




**Company:** 
 Kritsnam Technologies
 



**Employment:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 2\-5 Years of hands\-on paid Meta and Google advertising experience
 



**About the role** 




 Kritsnam builds smart water\-metering and management solutions. We are hiring a hands\-on Performance Marketing Executive to run Meta and Google Ads campaigns for our Dhaara products.
 



 You will work directly with the founder, who provides marketing strategy, creative direction, audience inputs and budget approvals. Your responsibility is to execute accurately, monitor performance and turn campaign data into useful recommendations. 
 



**What you will do** 



* Set up and manage Meta and Google Ads campaigns using approved creatives, audiences and budgets.
* Monitor daily spending, campaign delivery, ad approvals, landing\-page links and lead flow.
* Manage audience lists, lookalike audiences and remarketing using approved customer data.
* Review Google search terms and maintain relevant negative keywords.
* Run structured tests of creatives, audiences and ad copy; document changes and results.
* Maintain a clear dashboard connecting ad spend to leads, qualified enquiries, quotations and sales.
* Coordinate with the sales team to understand lead quality and closure outcomes.
* Recommend what to scale, pause or improve, with supporting data.
* Check conversion tracking and flag technical issues promptly.



**What we are looking for** 



* Practical experience using
 **Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads** 
 —not only social\-media posting or boosting posts.
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets and interpreting campaign performance.
* Understands CPC, CTR, CPL, conversion rate and customer acquisition cost.
* Basic familiarity with Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, UTM tracking and conversion events.
* Strong attention to detail, numerical ability and disciplined follow\-through.
* Willingness to learn the product and understand why leads do—or do not—become customers.



 Experience with lead\-generation campaigns or physical products is a plus. Relevant internships and freelance campaign experience count.
 



**How success will be measured** 




 Accurate execution, controlled spending, reliable reporting, better\-qualified enquiries and contribution to sales—not simply more clicks or cheaper leads.
 



**How to apply** 




 Share your CV\-akhila@kritsnam.com and a brief example of a campaign you personally managed: its objective, approximate budget, your responsibilities and results. Anonymised screenshots are welcome; do not share confidential client information.
 



 Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical campaign\-analysis and setup exercise.

title: Marketing Product Manager (Salesforce)
description:
**Description**
 Marketing Product Manager (Salesforce)
   

  

 Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
   

  

 Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
   

  

 Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
   

  

 Why Syneos Health
   

  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.


**Job Responsibilities**
 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Own MarTech products across discovery, business\-case development, roadmap prioritization, delivery, adoption and value realization.
* Define product vision, strategy and roadmap based on business, customer and user needs.
* Translate and prioritize business needs into product requirements, user stories, technical requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritize product features and manage the backlog in partnership with engineering, data, UX and technology teams.
* Develop solutions supporting B2B marketing and demand generation, including ABM, lead capture, nurturing, scoring, routing, campaign management and attribution.
* Drive integrations across marketing platforms, Salesforce CRM, websites, customer data platforms, analytics tools and third\-party data providers.
* Define and track KPIs including adoption, funnel performance, lead\-to\-opportunity conversion, attribution, pipeline contribution and business value.
* Partner across Marketing, Sales, Technology, Data, Privacy, Security and Compliance to deliver scalable solutions.
* Evaluate and introduce AI\-enabled marketing capabilities where they deliver measurable value.
* Manage vendors, implementation partners, contracts and platform evaluations.
* Lead change\-management activities including communication, training, adoption and feedback management.
* Clearly communicate product recommendations, priorities, technical concepts and trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders and executives.
* Mentor and coach junior team members and build strong internal and external partnerships.


**Experience \& Requirements**
* 5\+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B enterprise Marketing Technology (MarTech).
* Experience owning digital products from discovery and roadmap through delivery, adoption and value realization.
* Strong knowledge of B2B marketing and demand\-generation processes, including ABM, lead management, campaigns and attribution.
* Experience with Salesforce CRM and MarTech platforms such as Marketing Cloud Account Engagement/Pardot, Demandbase, 6sense, event platforms, DAM, CMS or similar tools.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, APIs, data flows, analytics, identity/consent considerations and third\-party data sources.
* Strong product strategy, roadmap, backlog management, prioritization and Agile delivery skills.
* Data\-driven approach to KPIs, adoption measures, funnel metrics, attribution and business\-value targets.
* Proven cross\-functional stakeholder management across Marketing, Sales, Technology, Data, Privacy, Security and Compliance.
* Experience managing vendors, implementation partners, contracts and technology evaluations.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled marketing capabilities.
* Excellent communication, customer\-centric discovery, problem solving and change\-management skills.


**Additional Qualifications**
* Experience with roadmap, issue and backlog management systems such as Azure DevOps.
* Experience with design tools such as Figma.
* Understanding of business intelligence, data science/engineering workflows, database concepts and architecture; familiarity with analytical languages such as Python, R, Scala or Java is beneficial.
* Motivated and self\-guided learner with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical audiences


**Get to know Syneos Health**
 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.
   

  

 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
   

  

 http://www.syneoshealth.com
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
   

  

**Summary**
 The Technology \& Data Solutions (TDS) business unit is the Syneos Health accelerator for life sciences innovation. TDS brings together advanced technology, data solutions, homegrown products and applications to support enterprise\-wide innovation and adoption. The Product Manager partners with business teams, engineers, developers, data teams and UX to develop scalable, production\-ready products that support customer and business needs. This role focuses on B2B Marketing Technology (MarTech), owning digital products that enable marketing, demand generation, sales alignment and measurable business outcomes

title: Digital marketing executives
description:
**Company Description** 
 ReatchAll is a growing organization focused on helping businesses strengthen their digital presence and customer reach. The company offers a range of marketing and digital solutions designed to improve brand visibility and engagement. Team members collaborate across functions to deliver data\-driven strategies and measurable results. ReatchAll values innovation, adaptability, and continuous learning, creating opportunities for professional growth. The work environment supports inclusive, ethical practices and encourages contributions from diverse perspectives.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for Digital Marketing Executives based in Serilingampalli. In this position, you will plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across channels such as social media, search, and web, aligned with business goals. You will manage and optimize social media accounts, create and update web content, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure brand consistency. Daily responsibilities include monitoring campaign performance using web analytics tools, preparing reports, and making data\-driven recommendations. You will also support communication initiatives, assist in developing marketing collateral, and stay current with digital marketing trends and best practices.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in Marketing and Social Media Marketing, with experience executing campaigns across key digital platforms.
* Effective Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication for internal collaboration and external messaging.
* Ability in Web Content Writing to create concise, engaging, and brand\-aligned content for websites and digital channels.
* Working knowledge of Web Analytics tools to track performance, interpret data, and provide actionable insights.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proficiency with common digital marketing tools (e.g., social media management platforms, basic SEO concepts, email marketing tools).
* Attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new digital strategies, tools, and industry trends.

title: Regional Launch Director SIR
description:
**Job Description Summary**
* Job Description


 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the
   

  

 launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional
   

  

 collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional
   

  

 launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing
   

  

 mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the
   

  

 short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close
   

  

 collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and
   

  

 support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Purpose:**
 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Proactively lead the development and implementation of strategic regional launch readiness.
* Monitor the launch performance, competitive environment to quickly identify plan changes.
* Manage ROI assessments of tactical programs \& through collaboration with Commercial Leadership, develop and execute action plans to address competitive threats and/ or exogenous market events, maximizing pipeline value.
* Engage with other functional teams to ensure operational launch readiness of Region SIR launches and ensure E2E coordination to maximize commercial opportunities.
* Collaborate with Platforms on critical issues related to market commercialization, aligning as appropriate to their global product launch strategy.
* Together with Supply Chain and Platforms, drive decisions for regional product allocations if needed, at\-risk manufacturing and API purchases to optimize upsides and mitigate risk.
* Provide leadership to the market team and extended functional launch team members including coaching, advising, and developing team members
* Ensure compliance with Sandoz policies and procedures and full integration into the Sandoz culture and support resources
* Perform other duties as required by the Region from time to time.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* A minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in the GLP\-1 or Biosimilar field
* Sales/commercial leadership and mindset
* Sound Project Management experience (min 5 years)
* Hands\-on approach combined with business acumen, strategic thinking, and pragmatism
* Experience in managing/leading cross\-functional matrix teams
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills
* Stakeholder engagement with respect for different cultures and diverse groups.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human rightof access to good healthcare.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
   

  

**Skills Desired**
 Agility, Brand Awareness, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Customer Engagement, Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Data Strategy, Digital Marketing, Go\-To\-Market Strategy, Influencing Skills, Inspirational Leadership, Marketing Strategy, Media Campaigns, People Management, Product Marketing, Product Roadmap, Return on Investment (ROI), Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Marketing
